name: FireShutterCurtain
split: moving slat curtain of the fire shutter incl. the 60 mm bottom bar and its two lift handles
alignedWith: FireShutterBox: same depth origin, so place it at FireShutterBox pivot + curtainPlaceAtM

curtain.ribsIn: normal map (slat grooves, 7 strips of about 6.4 ribs per face); the mesh is 7 flat strips per face
curtain.animate: scale Y (Unity) from 0 (up, hidden in the box) to 1 (down) about the pivot at the top; the ribs compress with it; the bottom bar and handles are part of the curtain and squash with the scale

sizeBasis: curtain of the Poly Haven rollershutter_door stretched to 4.02 m x 4.0 m (see FireShutterBox)
